what: Human review after stage E (e-strict.json): from the 21 leads that passed every automatic check to the 9 shown in the presentation. Every reason below can be checked against the quote stored in e-strict.json.
rule: keep a lead only if (1) its single-drug evidence quote states an anti-glioblastoma RESULT in animals or humans, and (2) its blood-brain barrier quote says it crosses ("yes").

removed_after_reading_the_quote.why: the evidence quote says it had no effect on glioblastoma growth ("had no effect on the growth of SF-295 glioblastoma")
the quote reports cell lines only ("suppressed proliferation and stemness in glioma-initiating cell lines"), not an animal result
the quote states the aim of the study, not a result ("we investigated the anti-GBM activity…")

caveats: moxidectin: the brain quote comes from a toxicity study (accumulation in the central nervous system of mice), weak evidence of useful brain exposure
clemastine: the evidence quote says a mouse glioma model was susceptible, without a survival figure
cimetidine and lomitapide: effect shown in combination with temozolomide (standard care), not alone
the final check by Mission Zero (one full mission per drug) has not run: Meta API access restricted on 2 November 2026, 12:30 UTC
status: HYPOTHESES. Leads for researchers, not treatments: mouse results, not yet in humans.
